title: Larger or Smaller Reward Margins to Select Preferences for LLM Alignment?
authors_zh: Kexin Huang、Junkang Wu、Ziqian Chen 等（中国科学技术大学、独立研究者）
paper_type_zh: 偏好间隔驱动的数据选择与对齐研究
best_for_zh: 适合需要从固定偏好对中选择更有训练价值记录的读者。
one_line: Alignment Potential selects preference pairs whose current policy margin differs most from the reward-model target margin.
对齐潜力指标选择当前策略间隔与奖励目标间隔差距最大的偏好对。
why: It changes data use from selecting only easy or only high-reward pairs to selecting pairs with the most estimated room for alignment.
inclusion_reason: Scores and selects preference records according to the gap between a current policy state and an external reward target.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Offline preference optimization is highly sensitive to which response pairs it consumes. Existing selectors often favor either a large external reward margin or a small margin under the current policy, but the two signals can rank the same pair in opposite ways. Neither rule directly says how far the policy is from the preference behavior that the external reward model represents.

This paper asks which pairs have the greatest remaining capacity to improve a policy's alignment. It reframes selection as measuring the difference between the current policy's implicit margin and a target explicit reward margin, then chooses records where closing that gap is expected to be most useful.

离线偏好优化对实际使用哪些回答对非常敏感。已有选择器通常偏好较大的外部奖励间隔，或偏好当前策略下较小的间隔，但这两种信号可能对同一回答对给出相反排序。两条规则都没有直接说明策略距离外部奖励模型所表示的偏好行为还有多远。

本文追问哪些回答对仍具有最大的策略对齐改进空间。它将选择重新表述为测量当前策略的隐式间隔与目标显式奖励间隔之间的差异，然后选择那些缩小该差异预计最有价值的记录。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The alignment-potential metric combines two views of a preference pair. The explicit margin comes from an external reward model and represents the desired ranking; the implicit margin comes from the current policy relative to its reference policy and represents its present ranking. Their discrepancy estimates how much alignment signal the pair can still provide.

Pairs are ranked by this estimated potential and the top subset is used for preference optimization. The same score also guides an evolve-then-select pipeline: generated prompts and responses are annotated, then the metric keeps the generated pairs with the strongest estimated usefulness. The method therefore changes both the filtering of existing data and the consumption of self-generated data.

对齐潜力指标结合了对偏好对的两种观察。显式间隔来自外部奖励模型，表示期望的排序；隐式间隔来自当前策略相对于其参考策略的差异，表示它当前的排序。这两者的差异估计该偏好对仍能提供多少对齐信号。

回答对按这一估计潜力排序，top 子集被用于偏好优化。同一分数也指导“演化后选择”流水线：生成提示和回答后先进行标注，再由该指标保留估计效用最强的生成回答对。因此，该方法同时改变已有数据的筛选和自生成数据的使用。

title: Method
方法
html:
For each pair, the method computes an explicit reward difference from a reward model and an implicit difference from policy and reference-policy log probabilities. Their gap is the alignment-potential score. The implementation first adds the required log probabilities to a SimPO-format preference dataset, then uses a metric-selection script to retain the top-k examples.

The released repository also contains an evolve-then-select path: it evolves prompts, generates response pairs, annotates them with a reward model, processes the resulting records, and selects a subset by the metric. The selected data are finally used in a SimPO-style alignment recipe, so the score is a data-use decision rather than a replacement loss.

对于每个回答对，方法从奖励模型计算显式奖励差异，并从策略和参考策略的对数概率计算隐式差异。二者的间隔就是对齐潜力分数。实现会先向 SimPO 格式的偏好数据集加入所需的对数概率，再用指标选择脚本保留 top-k 样本。

公开仓库还包含“演化后选择”路径：它演化提示、生成回答对、用奖励模型标注、处理所得记录，并用该指标选择一个子集。最终，所选数据用于 SimPO 风格的对齐方案，因此该分数是一项数据使用决策，而不是替换损失函数。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The ICML paper reports that training on alignment-potential-selected data consistently outperforms the compared margin metrics across base models and preference-optimization objectives. It also reports that the metric remains useful in self-play generation, improving as the generated dataset and the number of training iterations increase.

The evidence comes from the published ICML evaluation and a released implementation that exposes dataset log-probability processing, top-k selection, and generated-data selection. It supports the claim that the two-margin discrepancy is useful in the authors' tested settings, but it does not prove that a reward model's target margin is unbiased or that the selected set is optimal for an untested deployment preference.

ICML 论文报告，在多个基础模型和偏好优化目标上，使用对齐潜力所选数据进行训练，持续优于所比较的间隔指标。它还报告，该指标在自博弈生成中仍然有用，并会随着生成数据集规模和训练迭代次数增加而带来持续改进。

证据来自已发表的 ICML 评估和公开实现，后者提供数据集对数概率处理、top-k 选择以及生成数据选择。它支持两种间隔差异在作者测试设置中有用的主张，但不能证明奖励模型的目标间隔没有偏见，也不能证明所选集合对未测试部署偏好最优。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier selection rules treat large explicit margins or small implicit margins as separate data-quality criteria. This work makes their disagreement the signal: a pair is valuable when the model's current comparative behavior is far from the reward-model target, not merely when one margin is extreme.

Its contribution is a selection metric and executable pipeline, rather than a new preference corpus or a new preference-optimization objective. By using the same metric for both fixed data and generated data, it connects record scoring to a concrete training consumer and exposes the additional log-probability and reward-model dependencies needed to reproduce that decision.

较早的选择规则将较大的显式间隔或较小的隐式间隔视为彼此独立的数据质量标准。本工作将它们的分歧作为信号：当模型当前的比较行为远离奖励模型目标时，回答对才有价值，而不只是某一个间隔很极端。

其贡献是选择指标和可执行流水线，而不是新的偏好语料或新的偏好优化目标。通过把同一指标用于固定数据和生成数据，它将记录打分连接到具体的训练使用者，并公开了复现该决策所需的额外对数概率和奖励模型依赖。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The metric assumes that an external reward model defines a useful target margin, so reward-model bias, calibration errors, and distribution shift can directly alter selection. It also needs policy and reference log probabilities, which adds preprocessing cost and ties results to model checkpoints and tokenization. In the self-generated setting, evolution, generation, annotation, and selection can form a feedback loop; reuse should evaluate whether this loop broadens capabilities or reinforces the reward model's blind spots.
该指标假定外部奖励模型定义了有用的目标间隔，因此奖励模型偏见、校准误差和分布变化会直接改变选择结果。它还需要策略和参考策略的对数概率，这增加预处理成本，并使结果绑定于模型检查点和分词方式。在自生成设置中，演化、生成、标注和选择可能形成反馈循环；复用时应评估这一循环是在扩展能力，还是在强化奖励模型的盲点。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when preference-data selection should reflect what the current policy has not yet learned, rather than only a static quality score. The code gives a direct path from a SimPO-style dataset to log probabilities, top-k metric selection, and training, and it also illustrates how to score synthetic pairs before they enter a training set. It is useful for controlled comparisons of margin criteria, provided the reward model and evaluation protocol are independently audited.
当偏好数据选择应反映当前策略尚未学会什么，而不是只依据静态质量分数时，应使用这项工作。代码提供从 SimPO 风格数据集到对数概率、top-k 指标选择和训练的直接路径，也说明如何在合成回答对进入训练集之前为其打分。它适用于受控比较不同间隔标准，前提是奖励模型和评估协议都经过独立审计。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the definition of the two margins before interpreting the ranking results: the score measures disagreement between a target reward model and a current policy, not an absolute human-quality label. Inspect the source and calibration of the reward model, the reference policy, the top-k ratio, and whether log probabilities were computed with matching preprocessing. For reproduction, run the repository's processing and selection stages separately, freeze the selection before final evaluation, and report both the selected-data characteristics and downstream alignment metrics.
应在解释排序结果之前先阅读两种间隔的定义：该分数测量目标奖励模型与当前策略之间的分歧，而不是绝对的人类质量标签。检查奖励模型的来源与校准、参考策略、top-k 比例，以及对数概率是否使用匹配的预处理计算。复现时应将仓库的处理和选择阶段分开运行，在最终评估前冻结选择，并同时报告所选数据的特征和下游对齐指标。
